sentences.text: Author: Sanjay Kumar Bench: Sanjay Kumar  IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA

CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION  CRIMINAL APPEAL NOS. OF 2025  (arising out of SLP(Crl.) Nos. 7665-7666 of 2025)
 VIBHAV JAIN ..... APPE  VERSUS  STATE OF UTTAR PRADESH & ORS. ..... RESPO  O R D E R Leave granted.

Having heard the learned counsel for the parties and upon considering the counter affidavits filed by the respondents, we are of the opinion that the protection granted by this Court to the appellant,
Vibhav Jain, on 15.05.2025, deserves to be made absolute.
The appeals are, accordingly, allowed; setting aside the impugned judgments/orders passed by the High Court.

In the event of his arrest in connection with First Information Report (FIR) No.554/2024 dated 20.08.2024 registered with Police Station  Baraut, District  Baghpat, Uttar Pradesh, for the offence(s) punishable under Sections 498A, 504, 506, 323, 307 and 313 of the Indian Penal Code,
1860, and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, the appellant, Vibhav Jain, shall be released on bail on such terms and conditions as may be fixed by the trial Court.

entities.text: Police Station  Baraut, District  Baghpat, Uttar Pradesh
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The appellant shall continue to cooperate with the investigation and shall also abide by the conditions stipulated in Section 482(2) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.

We clarify that we have not made any observations/comments on the merits of the case and any observation made in this order is meant only for the limited purposes of grant of anticipatory bail.
